atoms.exact_source_text: A simulation in which every Role must be staffed at all times regardless of context.
atoms.normalized_claim: Non-goal: a simulation requiring every Role to be staffed at all times regardless of context.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Home economy that creates unlimited advanced progression without Away materials and discoveries.
atoms.normalized_claim: Non-goal: a Home economy creating unlimited advanced progression without Away materials and discoveries.

atoms.exact_source_text: An emotional-content meter that turns friendship, memory, or EMBODY into another optimized currency.
atoms.normalized_claim: Non-goal: an emotional-content meter turning friendship, memory, or EMBODY into another optimized currency.

atoms.exact_source_text: A sensibly arranged colony with covered routine Loads can pass multiple ordinary Dawns without degradation or compulsory action.
atoms.normalized_claim: Acceptance test 'Stable plateau': a sensibly arranged colony with covered routine Loads can pass multiple ordinary Dawns without degradation or compulsory action.

atoms.exact_source_text: Before an Expedition, the player can understand exactly which Role share leaves and how margins change.
atoms.normalized_claim: Acceptance test 'Legible absence': before an Expedition, the player can understand exactly which Role share leaves and how margins change.

atoms.exact_source_text: Swapping two healthy present Citizens in the same Role does not alter Capacity.
atoms.normalized_claim: Acceptance test 'Equal Home value': swapping two healthy present Citizens in the same Role does not alter Capacity.

atoms.exact_source_text: The same population and functions produce visibly and mechanically different Mouse, Rabbit, and Squirrel settlements.
atoms.normalized_claim: Acceptance test 'Species distinction': the same population and functions produce visibly and mechanically different Mouse, Rabbit, and Squirrel settlements.

atoms.exact_source_text: Forecast pressure can be absorbed by readiness without opening MEET, and the player receives a brief diegetic confirmation.
atoms.normalized_claim: Acceptance test 'Silent success': forecast pressure can be absorbed by readiness without opening MEET, and the player receives a brief diegetic confirmation.

atoms.exact_source_text: The same Heavy Winds family presents different stakes under Builder/Caretaker versus Watchkeeper/Leader weakness profiles.
atoms.normalized_claim: Acceptance test 'Weakness manifestation': the same Heavy Winds family presents different stakes under Builder/Caretaker versus Watchkeeper/Leader weakness profiles.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Home Encounter presents two materially different spends and a meaningful refusal, with understandable consequence previews.
atoms.normalized_claim: Acceptance test 'Three-choice clarity': a Home Encounter presents two materially different spends and a meaningful refusal, with understandable consequence previews.

atoms.exact_source_text: Resolving an Encounter normally completes the shortfall transaction without automatically spawning a second mandatory repair minigame.
atoms.normalized_claim: Acceptance test 'No double charge': resolving an Encounter normally completes the shortfall transaction without automatically spawning a second mandatory repair minigame.

atoms.exact_source_text: A strained colony has clear, achievable routes back to Quiet Equilibrium and is not trapped in escalating event spam.
atoms.normalized_claim: Acceptance test 'Recovery possibility': a strained colony has clear, achievable routes back to Quiet Equilibrium and is not trapped in escalating event spam.

atoms.exact_source_text: When Quiet Equilibrium is restored, EMBODY becomes globally available at Home without checking individual Role margins.
atoms.normalized_claim: Acceptance test 'EMBODY reward': when Quiet Equilibrium is restored, EMBODY becomes globally available at Home without checking individual Role margins.

atoms.exact_source_text: Named Citizens, Places, Projects, and Encounters can be referenced later as shared history even though Home output remains global.
atoms.normalized_claim: Acceptance test 'Campaign continuity': named Citizens, Places, Projects, and Encounters can be referenced later as shared history even though Home output remains global.
Acceptance test 'Advancement boundary': Home sustains and transforms.

atoms.exact_source_text: significant new capabilities still depend on Away discovery, salvage, knowledge, or relationships.
atoms.normalized_claim: Acceptance test 'Advancement boundary': significant new capabilities still depend on Away discovery, salvage, knowledge, or relationships.

atoms.exact_source_text: The Home Loop succeeds when the colony is mechanically credible, strategically legible, capable of genuine equilibrium, and emotionally spacious enough that the player can care about the small lives the system protects.
atoms.normalized_claim: Final system statement: the Home Loop succeeds when the colony is mechanically credible, strategically legible, capable of genuine equilibrium, and emotionally spacious enough that the player can care about the small lives the system protects.
